// External caller of unmodified SourceCommit. All records are synthetic.
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"time"

	"github.com/WuKongIM/WuKongIM/pkg/wkdb"
	"github.com/cockroachdb/pebble"
)

func must(err error) { if err != nil { panic(err) } }
type pair struct { Key, Value []byte }

func main() {
	dir, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "original-v2-plugin-binding-"); must(err)
	defer os.RemoveAll(dir)
	open := func() wkdb.DB {
		db := wkdb.NewWukongDB(wkdb.NewOptions(wkdb.WithDir(dir), wkdb.WithNodeId(1), wkdb.WithShardNum(2)))
		must(db.Open()); return db
	}
	db := open()
	at := time.Unix(1700000000, 123456789).UTC()
	must(db.AddUser(wkdb.User{Uid: "bound-user"}))
	must(db.AddOrUpdatePlugin(wkdb.Plugin{No: "legacy-receive", Priority: 7, Methods: []string{"Receive"}}))
	must(db.AddOrUpdatePluginUsers([]wkdb.PluginUser{{PluginNo: "legacy-receive", Uid: "bound-user", CreatedAt: &at, UpdatedAt: &at}}))
	must(db.Close())
	db = open()
	user, err := db.GetUser("bound-user"); must(err)
	exists, err := db.ExistPluginByUid("bound-user"); must(err)
	selected, err := db.GetHighestPriorityPluginByUid("bound-user"); must(err)
	bindings, err := db.GetPluginUsers("legacy-receive"); must(err)
	if !exists || selected != "legacy-receive" || len(bindings) != 1 || user.PluginNo != "" { panic("unexpected original binding read") }
	must(db.Close())
	raw, err := pebble.Open(filepath.Join(dir, "wukongimdb", "shard000"), &pebble.Options{ReadOnly: true}); must(err)
	iter := raw.NewIter(nil)
	var rows []pair
	for iter.First(); iter.Valid(); iter.Next() {
		k := iter.Key()
		if len(k) >= 2 && k[0] == 0x16 && k[1] == 1 {
			rows = append(rows, pair{append([]byte(nil), k...), append([]byte(nil), iter.Value()...)})
		}
	}
	must(iter.Error()); must(iter.Close()); must(raw.Close())
	result := map[string]any{"uid": "bound-user", "plugin_no": selected, "user_plugin_no_empty": user.PluginNo == "", "exists": exists, "binding_count": len(bindings), "created_at_ns": at.UnixNano(), "rows": rows}
	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(result, "", "  "); must(err)
	must(os.WriteFile(os.Args[1], append(data, '\n'), 0600))
}
